name: misbehaving-tx05
description: Methodology test fixture for TX-05. Implements the CTL-01 cases correctly in every mode, so that its TX-05 results are not gated, and TX-05.explicit-serializable correctly in mode ok and broken in each other mode. Its manifest claims support for SERIALIZABLE, so a rejection is a rejection of a documented level.

modes.description: Correct: BEGIN ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE, and an honest report.
Runs REPEATABLE READ when SERIALIZABLE was requested, and reports it honestly.
Runs READ COMMITTED, but reports SERIALIZABLE.
Runs SERIALIZABLE, but reports READ COMMITTED.
Runs SERIALIZABLE, but reads uniq instead of item.
Runs SERIALIZABLE, but does not report the level.
Rejects the request with an error of its own, then runs a plain transaction through the same form.
Rejects the request with PostgreSQL's error for an invalid BEGIN (a SQLSTATE), then runs a plain transaction.
Rejects the request with an error of its own, and runs no plain transaction.
